html:
Mpalitjanh, or Mpalityan, is the name of a people and their speech in the north of Cape York Peninsula, Queensland. It and Luthigh were two dialects of one language, once spoken inland from the west coast north of today's Weipa.

Almost nothing else is recorded. Their neighbours on the map were the Anguthimri, Awngthim and Yinwum. Like most small groups of the far north, they were hit hard by mission removals and the cattle and mining frontier, and the language is no longer spoken.
